Class WorkbenchTransportClient

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.workbench.transport.WorkbenchTransportClient
public final class WorkbenchTransportClient extends Object
Workbench-aware sibling of TransportClient.

Speaks the ttio-transport WS subprotocol against tti-workbench-server v1.0.0+. Supports authenticated uploads, authenticated downloads (with optional selective-access filtering), and resumable uploads via ResumeState.

Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.transport.UploadClient / DownloadClient. The JSON shapes on the wire are byte-identical to the Python builder so the cross-language equivalence test can compare them directly.

Thread model: one client instance drives one operation (upload OR download). For concurrent operations, construct multiple instances. The class is not designed for re-use across operations.

    • upload

      public WorkbenchTransportClient.UploadResult upload(String project, String containerUri, byte[] payload, ResumeState resume, TransferProgress progress)
      Upload with optional resume state + a progress callback. progress (nullable) is invoked with (bytesSent, payload.length) as chunks are enqueued, plus a final (length, length) once fully sent.

    • download

      public WorkbenchTransportClient.DownloadResult download(String containerUri, Map<String,Object> filter, WorkbenchHandshake.OutputMode outputMode, int maxAu, TransferProgress progress)
      Download with a progress callback. The server streams without a known content length, so progress is invoked with (bytesReceived, TransferProgress.UNKNOWN_TOTAL) as binary frames arrive — consumers show bytes-so-far.
